history.reason: Phase 2.2 Batch 2: Correction found during direct verification: Wikipedia's article (cross-checked against NYSED's own op.nysed.gov pages) is titled 'New York State Board FOR Nursing', not 'of Nursing'. NYSED's own site confirms nursing licensure in NY is administered by the Office of the Professions (an education-department division), with the Board for Nursing serving in an advisory capacity — New York is structurally different from most other states, which have a standalone licensing board. officialWebsite value itself (op.nysed.gov) was already correct; only the licensingBoard NAME needed correction.

endorsementFeeUsd.sourceName: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions

history.reason: Phase 2.5: first population of this field from an official primary source. NYSED's dedicated nursing endorsement page states the Form 1 application fee for RNs/LPNs already licensed elsewhere is $143. Note: a separate generic multi-profession NYSED fee chart (opfeechart.pdf) lists a differently-labeled '$50 Endorsement (Relocation)' line of unclear profession scope; the profession-specific page ($143) is preferred as the direct, unambiguous source for this field, and the discrepancy is documented here rather than silently dropped.

conflicts.reasonForConflict: NYSED publishes two different fee figures that could plausibly apply to RN endorsement: a generic all-professions fee chart states $50 under an ambiguous 'Endorsement (Relocation)' line item with no clear profession attribution, while the nursing-specific endorsement page explicitly states $143 as the Form 1 application fee for RNs/LPNs licensed elsewhere. These cannot both be the RN endorsement fee.
conflicts.resolutionReason: Specificity tier: "New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions" (jurisdiction-general, rank 2) vs "New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions" (profession-specific, rank 3) — Endorsement of Nursing Licenses - RPN is more narrowly scoped to this exact fact, so it wins.
